label: l/i/g input at original position 2-3
explanation: Fires almost only in the original phase at steps t=2 and t=3 (97% of mass; nothing at t<2 or t>=5, a small amount at t=4, 4% of mass on <DEL> when L=3, never in the copy phase). Within that window it is strongly selective for the input tokens l, i, g (about 77% of mass), more weakly for 0 and d/o/b/w. Only about 43% of l/i/g inputs at t=2-3 fire, and the earlier prefix modulates this: rate and magnitude are higher when the first token is j/e/1/z/c/h and the token two back is e/j/c/z, with top activations like j e x [g] and j j x [i]. Adding these prefix sets as conditions did not raise F1. Mostly fires on the first occurrence of the token. Does not fire on other letters at these positions, on later original positions, or anywhere in the copy phase. Dev F1 about 0.52, mass recall 0.75.
